'**Instant** - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Draw a card.' Generic Equipment - Head.

SHAPE copied from .drafts/calming_cloak.json / .drafts/amethyst_amulet_blue.json (same 'Instant - <cost>, destroy this: <payoff>' family; amethyst's sibling is shipped as sea/platinum_amulet_blue). The {r}{r}{r} is the card-level activation_cost (DSL-authoritative, read by play.py's shared affordability gate for DSL activated abilities) - deliberately NOT also authored as a PAY_RESOURCES ability cost, which would double-charge per IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE. 'destroy this' is the ability-level cost [{DESTROY_SELF}] - a real cost type (cost_types.py:43), so it can block the activation and routes through canonical destroy(), which resolves the equipment slot. INSTANT maps to ON_ACTIVATE (trigger_types.py:115) and instant activations on equipment are offered by play._add_dsl_activations at any priority window, paying costs before dispatch.

DRAW reads amount/player (effect_types.py:1222-1224); player defaults SELF = controller, which is what the bare 'Draw a card' means. No printed keywords on this card.

SET FOLDER AT ADOPTION: HeavyHitters -> json/hvy/ (where the sibling aurum_aegis lives).
